note: Gunnison RD (GMUG): ~9,600 ft in the upper Taylor River valley, 3.75 mi above Taylor Park Reservoir and ~35 mi up Taylor Canyon Rd from Almont (improved dirt past the Cottonwood Pass turnoff). Ponderosa loop beside the Taylor River plus an open sage loop with the pull-throughs; popular with OHV riders, Collegiate Peaks Wilderness 4 mi east. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 232152 + its per-site catalog: confirmed 22 sites, vault toilets, potable water, $18 (2026; extra vehicle $9), reservable. Added sites detail (max 50 ft stated, six 99-ft pull-throughs, pull_through true), booking rules (cutoff 4 days, 2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max, reservation season June 19 - Sept 12, first-come shoulders and site 009), season wording. Hookups left (catalog all nonelectric; water/sewer not stated). Pin is at the entrance junction ~300 m east of the site centroid (38.90569,-106.58678), under the 500 m bound. Note trimmed.
